conda_environment_sources.environment-dev.yml:
# siRNAforge Local Development Environment
# This environment includes both bioinformatics tools and Python dependencies
# for complete local development without Docker

name: sirnaforge-dev
channels:
- conda-forge
- bioconda
- nodefaults
dependencies:
# Python runtime
- python=3.12

# Core bioinformatics tools (from Docker environment)
- openjdk >=17,<25
- nextflow >=25.04.0
- bwa-mem2 >=2.2.1
- samtools >=1.19.2
- viennarna >=2.7.0
- awscli >=2.0
- curl
- wget
- jq
- pigz
- htslib
- pysam

# Python scientific stack
- numpy >=1.26.0
- pandas >=2.3.0
- matplotlib >=3.7.0
- seaborn >=0.12.0
- jupyter >=1.0.0
- plotly >=5.15.0

# Python bioinformatics and data libraries
- biopython >=1.84
- requests >=2.32.0
- aiohttp >=3.12.0
- httpx >=0.28.0

# Python development and CLI tools
- click >=8.0.0
- rich >=14.0.0
- typer >=0.17.0
- pydantic >=2.11.0
- pandera >=0.26.0

# Development tools
- pytest >=8.0
- pytest-cov >=6.0
- pytest-mock >=3.15
- pytest-asyncio >=1.1.0
- pytest-xdist >=3.8
- ruff >=0.12.0
- mypy >=1.10
- pre-commit >=3.8
- codespell >=2.4.0
- bandit[toml] >=1.7.0
- safety >=3.0.0,<4.0.0

# Documentation tools
- sphinx >=7.3.0
- sphinx-rtd-theme >=2.0.0
- myst-parser >=2.0.0
- sphinx-autodoc-typehints >=2.0.0
- linkify-it-py >=2.0.3
- sphinx-autobuild >=2024.9.19
- sphinx-design >=0.6.0
- sphinxcontrib-mermaid >=1.0.0

# Type stubs for better development experience
- types-requests >=2.32.0
- pandas-stubs >=2.1.0

# Additional utilities
- git
- htop
- tree
- tmux
- vim
- nano
conda_environment_sources.docker/environment-nextflow.yml:
# siRNAforge Docker environment
channels:
- conda-forge
- bioconda
- defaults
dependencies:
# Java runtime (required for Nextflow)
- openjdk >=17,<25

# Workflow management
- nextflow >=25.04.0

# Sequence alignment tools
- bwa-mem2 >=2.2.1
- samtools >=1.19.2

# RNA analysis
- viennarna >=2.7.0

# Cloud storage and utilities
- awscli >=2.0
- curl
- wget

# JSON processing
- jq

# Compression utilities
- pigz
- htslib
# Keep Python runtime and native/binary packages in conda. Pure-Python
# dependencies will be installed by pip from wheels during the wheel
# installation step (pip will skip packages already installed here).
- python=3.12
- pysam

caveat: Tool version probes are PATH observations, not successful workflow execution. Nextflow may try network access; probe is bounded by timeout.
